task.goal_en: Вы приехали в отель вечером. Назовите бронь (или попросите номер без брони), решите, что делать, если номер ещё не готов, и узнайте про завтрак и Wi-Fi.
task.completion_criteria_en: Ученик назвал бронь и продиктовал фамилию по буквам, отреагировал на неготовый номер, понял время завтрака и номер комнаты.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Good evening! Welcome. Do you have a reservation?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Yes, I do. The booking is under Karimova.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Could you spell your last name, please?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Sure. K-A-R-I-M-O-V-A.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Thank you. A double room for three nights... Oh, I'm sorry, your room isn't ready yet.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: That's OK. How long do I need to wait?

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: About twenty minutes. You can wait in the lobby. Would you like some tea?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Yes, please. Thank you.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Can I see your passport, please?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Sure, here it is.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Thank you. Breakfast is from seven to ten, on the second floor.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Great. What's the Wi-Fi password?

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: It's on this card, with your key. You're in room five-one-two, on the fifth floor.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Room five-one-two, fifth floor. Thank you!

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: You're welcome. Enjoy your stay!

task.goal_en: Вы в аэропорту Ташкента и летите в Лондон. Пройдите регистрацию: покажите документы, сдайте багаж, выберите место и поймите информацию о задержке рейса.
task.completion_criteria_en: Ученик ответил на вопросы о рейсе и багаже, решил проблему с перевесом, выбрал место и понял новое время посадки и номер выхода.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Good morning! Where are you flying to today?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: To London, please.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Can I see your passport and ticket, please?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Sure. Here's my passport, and the ticket's on my phone.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Thank you. How many bags are you checking in?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Just the one suitcase.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Please put it on the scale... It's twenty-five kilos. The limit is twenty-three.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Oh. Can I put my sneakers in my carry-on?

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Good. Now it's twenty-two kilos. Perfect.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Thanks a lot.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Would you like a window or an aisle seat?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Aisle, please.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Here's your boarding pass. I'm afraid the flight is delayed by one hour. Boarding is now at ten fifteen, at gate twelve.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: OK, gate twelve at ten fifteen. Got it, thanks.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a good flight!

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Hello. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: I have a sore throat and a cough.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. When did it start?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: It start two days ago.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Do you have a temperature?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: No, I don't think so.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: OK. Are you allergic to any medicine?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: No, I'm not.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: These throat sweets will help. Please read the instructions on the box. And drink lots of warm water.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Thank you. I'll take them. How much are they?

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: The small box is sold out, I'm afraid. The big box is eight pounds. Is that OK?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: That's fine. Here you are.

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Here you are. I hope you feel better soon!

turns.speaker: learner

turns.speaker: character
turns.text: Great! It starts at six. See you on Friday!

turns.speaker: learner
